newsitem.title: USA: Fannie Mae looking for new vice chair - CEO.
newsitem.headline: Fannie Mae looking for new vice chair - CEO.

text.p: The Federal National Mortgage Association has just begun searching for a new vice chairman to replace Franklin Raines, the head of Fannie Mae said Thursday.
Raines was sworn in last week as the director of the Office of Management and Budget.

"We've just begun the process of considering who it should be. I didn't really want to get started on it until he (Raines) was finally confirmed and had made his move to OMB," James Johnson, chairman and chief executive officer of Fannie Mae, told reporters after a National Press Club speech.
The company will have a statement within a few weeks on the job description, Johnson said.

"It'll certainly be somebody with a very substantial business background, somebody who has an ability to contribute to our business strategy, somebody with a substantial technology background," Johnson said.
Raines replaced Alice Rivlin who left OMB to join the Federal Reserve Board as vice chairwoman.
